title: Marswalk Budget
description: Mars walking-route planner built with a team of four at the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge (“Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map”). An astronaut picks science stops on real terrain at Gale or Jezero Crater, and the planner compares routes by walking time, suit oxygen, radiation dose and science value, then replans for dust storms, solar events or a heavy sample kit. Built the console UI and integrated the team's work into it (route options, turn-by-turn steps, Go/No-Go conditions, presenter tour), processed USGS elevation and THEMIS thermal-inertia data into a terrain grid with Node.js, ran QA, recorded the demo video and published the site on GitHub Pages.

title: CREII Website
description: Independently designed and developed the website of CREII (Centre de référence des élèves issus de l'immigration) using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS and WordPress. Built it from the ground up with responsive, multilingual interfaces and reusable components, connected Angular to WordPress through custom REST APIs, developed a Google Drive-based photo gallery, and integrated WooCommerce, Stripe, Brevo and IONOS.

title: QuietZone
description: IoT-based noise monitoring system using ESP32 sound sensors and a Raspberry Pi hub to collect and transmit real-time decibel data. Includes an Android application that displays live noise levels across multiple areas with automatic updates and simple noise categorization (low, medium, high), with Firebase for real-time data storage and admin features for sensor management, including registration and inactivity detection.

title: Bluetooth Touch Screen Macropad
description: Bluetooth-enabled application on an ESP32-S3 that sends predefined shortcut commands (e.g., opening apps like VS Code, GitHub, or Facebook). Features a touchscreen user interface built with LVGL on the AMOLED display of the LilyGO T4-S3 board to trigger actions through interactive controls, with hardware and software configured using PlatformIO.

title: Personal Portfolio Redesign
description: A new version of my personal website is in development, featuring a modern UI, improved accessibility, and enhanced performance. Stay tuned for updates!

title: Autonomous Hovercraft
description: Developed an autonomous hovercraft capable of navigating and solving mazes using sensor fusion. Implemented navigation algorithms using data from IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit), ultrasonic, and infrared sensors. Programmed in C for Arduino microcontroller with real-time obstacle detection and path planning.

title: COMP353 - Database Systems Project
description: Collaborative database design and implementation project for COMP353/COMP5531 Database Systems course. Developed normalized database schemas, implemented efficient SQL queries with joins and subqueries, and managed data integrity using MySQL. Worked in a team of 4 members to create comprehensive DDL/DML scripts and demonstrate database design principles.

title: COMP 371 - 3D Graphics Programming Project
description: Real-time 3D interactive application built in C++ using OpenGL. Features interactive camera controls, dynamic lighting with multiple moving light sources, textured 3D models, shadow mapping, particle effects, and post-processing effects including bloom and normal mapping. Developed in a team of 3 members using advanced graphics programming techniques and custom shader implementations.

title: ChatHaven
description: Built a full-stack group messaging platform with role-based permissions and real-time communication. Developed modular UI components (chat log, channel sidebar, etc.) and integrated the Giphy API, LinkPreview API, Gemini API. Used Git and GitHub for version control and collaboration in an Agile team environment.

title: Temperature Converter
description: Interactive temperature converter built with JavaFX as a final course project. Designed the user interface with CSS and implemented the logic for Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin conversions. Led a small team, coordinated development tasks, and ensured on-time project completion.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: Personal portfolio website built with Angular to showcase my projects, skills, and experience. Features responsive design, component-based architecture, and modern web development practices.

title: LeetCode Solutions
description: Collection of LeetCode challenge solutions demonstrating algorithmic problem-solving skills and data structure implementations. Regular practice to improve coding efficiency and algorithm optimization.

title: k-NN Classifier – Final Project
description: Developed a k-nearest neighbor machine learning model for medical data classification (569 instances). Collaborated with a team and applied algorithmic optimization strategies.

title: ESP32 LED Controller
description: The ESP32-LED-Controller project lets you wirelessly control LEDs via Bluetooth with features like button inputs, custom commands, and a timer functionality for automation. Programmed using C++ with ESP32-Arduino framework.

title: Electricity & Magnetism Simulation
description: Simulated electric fields from point charges and interactive logic gate circuits with a drag-and-drop interface and real-time output. Developed the application using Java, JavaFX for UI, and CSS for styling. Used Git and GitHub for version control and collaboration in an Agile team environment.

title: RetroPie Gaming Console on Raspberry Pi
description: Configured emulators, managed ROM libraries, and optimized system for retro gaming. Gained experience in Linux system setup, troubleshooting, and configuration.
